executionContext.description: Independent compatibility axis: where the observed stage actually executed. Open vocabulary for extensibility; well-known values listed as examples.

browserFamily.description: Normalized locally from the User-Agent; the raw UA string is never transmitted.

virtualization.description: Where the toolchain ran relative to real hardware. A container, a VM and bare metal are separate compatibility populations even when os and arch match.

libc.description: musl (alpine) vs glibc. Prebuilt native modules routinely load on one and fail on the other while every other dimension looks identical.

libcVersion.description: Recorded glibc major.minor when available; empty for musl and unknown implementations.

distro.description: Lowercase /etc/os-release ID such as ubuntu, debian, rhel, amzn or alpine.

ci.description: Automated runner. CI fleets are clones, so they must not be counted as many independent developer environments.
